concerns.text: The ExecutionLog schema (contracts/execution_log.schema.yaml) requires the fields `is_censored` and `limit_hit` (both booleans) as required properties. The plan’s description of the CSV output does not explicitly list these columns, nor does it state that they will be populated. Add a clear specification of the CSV column set to include `is_censored` and `limit_hit` (and any other required fields) so that the generated log conforms to the contract.

The SyntheticPuzzle schema (contracts/synthetic_puzzle.schema.yaml) mandates the presence of `target_path_id`, `seed`, and `is_orthogonal` fields. The plan’s Phase 1 description mentions a “Randomized Path Perturbation” but does not state that the generated JSONL will contain `target_path_id` (the selected ground‑truth path identifier), the random `seed` used, or an `is_orthogonal` flag indicating orthogonalization success. Amend the plan to explicitly record these required fields in each puzzle instance.
